definition_scope: Reference units from the official group descriptions. Original archive parameter history is authoritative for dates, operators and provenance; native names are retained.

P: barometric pressure reduced to sea level NN

F: wind speed; averaging operator requires dated parameter history
D: wind direction; averaging operator requires dated parameter history

ZENIT: solar zenith angle at interval midpoint

metadata.STATIONS_ID: DWD station ID, not WMO station number
metadata.MESS_DATUM: Primary source reference timestamp, preserved; UTC assignment uses dated archive metadata
metadata.QN_*: Native quality level codes; retained without automatic quality masking or admission
metadata.missing: -999 and equivalent decimal representations; original tokens retained in exported CSV

critical_distinctions: P0 is station pressure; P is sea-level-reduced pressure. They must not be interchanged.
P_STD is retained separately and is not automatically substituted for P0.
Moisture variables may be derived by the provider and are not independent direct measurements.
Radiation native hourly sums and minute-bearing timestamps are retained; no rounding, rebinning or conversion is performed.
Recent station coordinates do not establish historical sensor coordinates or pressure-sensor elevation.
